vb_textbox.text: 1. Put a podcast on, this game is boring and doesn't require much concentration. 2. Try and work out a pattern which gives the most mushrooms, if repeatedly getting low mushrooms then mix it up. 3. there are 4 gnomes, the brown hat and purple hat are always shown together, the green hat and red hat are always shown together. 4. At the start I picked brown hat then green gnome which seemed to provide a relatively high yield of mushrooms, when this stopped working I would pick purple then red hat but not sure if thats how the game works, couldn't see any obvious reasons as to why one gnome would provide more mushrooms than the other.
